notes.title: Cira face change
notes.content: [h1]Cira face change[/h1][p][/p][p]Cira's face initially had a stylized style, as I was originally testing a cel-shading/toon style for the project (this was partly for better optimization, as rendering this way would allow me to use lower-resolution textures).[/p][p]In the end, I achieved very good performance in the game, so I decided to give it a realistic style.[/p][p]Consequently, Cira's face needs to be modified to fit the game's visual style.[/p][p]Here are some renders of the change for comparison.[/p][p]The change is now integrated into the game.[/p][p]Hope you like it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/e7610287e3a811061a9ffe4dedb71f4b635ead2d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/4e9f8a6418d3bd5aa1571acd7c65ae2a0a0ef4e9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/ba3d8a89e19c64bb48b479ee848567ebd4dd24c9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/b9c15e1907587bcdaef0a5ed88b0d11a399e41a9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/b1d6f56b7732d41e044e70e371a501932b1f4d12.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580070/9afad9fc53d782322b31c9e25eb64594c17a4bcd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Follow the development on [url="https://patreon.com/TheAesthetik?utm_medium=unknown&utm_source=join_link&utm_campaign=creatorshare_creator&utm_content=copyLink"]Patreon[/url] or [url="https://subscribestar.adult/theaesthetik"]Suscribestar[/url][/p]
